description: Deterministic repository feature map for Mizyun

features.title: Meal & Nutrition Logging
features.summary: Manual food CRUD, keyset-paginated history/search, macro/calorie calculations, local-day offsets, offline drafts, and photo/text/refine generation with Pro nutrient estimates. Explicit opt-in recurring saved meals with server-side schedules and durable occurrence ledger. Dev-only optional compressed private meal thumbnails with explicit source choice and durable cleanup/retry. Automatic decorative catalog thumbnails and default-off private background illustrations, independent of meal saving. Pro-only meal visual display and photo retention with server/RPC/Storage downgrade fencing; common food catalog reuse avoids per-meal generation. Private deterministic three-day routine suggestions count explicit meal copies and require one-tap authorization to start tomorrow. Suggestions also cover clean two-week weekday rhythms (weekly_pattern, #253) at any logged time of day (#252); quick-add chips rank 30-day frequency weighted to the current time of day (#254); first-meal and evening reminders offer learned times the user must apply (#257).

relations.reason: Authenticated user context and RLS user_id filter
Food schema, nutrition breakdown contracts, and mutation types
Daily nutrition totals aggregate into energy balance and surplus/deficit
AI nutrition drafting and Coach nutrition advice access food entries

features.limitations: Reviewed against HEAD plus disclosed local pagination and meal-workflow changes. Live vision model photo drafting requires external provider evaluation per BEFORE_TESTING.md Retained meal photos require exact Dev/native/storage acceptance; Production disabled.
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-007/Q2: Durable unknown-outcome persistence for ambiguous retries across network drops
MEAL-PHOTO-001/#218: exact Dev/native thumbnail, retry, deletion and accessibility acceptance
NUTR-REC-002: exact-candidate Dev migration/client delivery and iOS/Android native accessibility, travel, app-closed generation and recovery acceptance; pilot thresholds remain unvalidated.

features.title: Workouts & Sets Tracking
features.summary: Custom exercises, workout templates, active workout session recovery, and progressive overload calculations. Workouts hub offers one-tap repeat of the last completed workout and a dismissible save-as-routine suggestion for exercise sets completed 3+ times in 28 days; saving is always explicit (#255). Indoor bouldering sessions (BOULDER-001, ADR-0066) log Font-graded boulders with results, projects and explicit sharing. Exercises have a tracking mode (load/reps, duration, or duration+distance; ADR-0068), and Log activity saves a finished swim, ride or other timed activity as a completed workout (#278); its Fill in from description asks AI first for users with AI consent, with the on-device parser as fallback (ADR-0073). The Exercise library creates, edits and deletes custom exercises with a tracking type; logged sets fix the type and block deletion (ADR-0075, #308).

relations.reason: User authentication and RLS ownership on exercise/workout records
Training contracts, exercise enums, and set volume interfaces
Coach workout recommendations read completed volume and workout sets

features.limitations: Active workout recovery is local-first in mobile state; cloud sync occurs on set/workout completion
openAcceptance: WO-07 exact-candidate standalone Dev start/add-before-first-set/restart/log/finish/history and appearance/accessibility acceptance (#187)
WO-08 Dev/iPhone log past workout enter/save/history/review, restart and offline retry, discard, large text/VoiceOver acceptance (#279)

features.summary: User onboarding profile, target goals and rate-based goal modes, deterministic Mifflin-St Jeor TDEE/BMR with trend weight and adaptive maintenance, weekly calorie review proposals, surplus/deficit dashboard, and weight trends.

relations.reason: Profile creation tied to auth user lifecycle and JWT claims
Shared profile, goals, and energy contracts
Coach advice grounds on user profile limitations and energy targets

features.limitations: Body weight entries are retrieved from body_measurements; wearable live step integration is post-MVP

features.title: Body Measurements & Private Media
features.summary: Weight and circumference tracking, user-scoped private media uploads, EXIF-stripped progress photos, and timeline comparison. Log weight shows the last value as a hint with an explicit Same-as-last control, and an opt-in weigh-in reminder uses neutral lock-screen copy with sign-out/deletion cleanup (#256). Meal and boulder photos are local-first: kept in a per-account device library and shown from there, with an optional Back up photos setting, background backfill and backup removal (ADR-0079).

relations.reason: Supabase Storage bucket policy requires matching auth.uid() folder prefix
Weight trends drive TDEE adaptation and surplus/deficit progress
Account deletion requires permanent deletion of user-scoped private media objects

features.limitations: Physical camera hardware capture tested manually; CI validates media uploads via synthetic fixtures
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-005: Non-diagnostic body photo policy evaluation with live provider
REL-AUD-007/Q2: weight restart/lost-response acceptance on delivered migration/API/native candidate; broader mutation retry inventory remains open
